tasks.title: Interactive Timeline Component

tasks.testStrategy: Test timeline with large datasets, verify zoom and filter functionality, and test real-time updates

subtasks.title: Create Timeline Data Model and WebSocket Events
subtasks.description: Define TypeScript interfaces for timeline data structures and WebSocket event types
subtasks.details: Create interfaces in shared/src/models/ for TimelineEntry, TimelineFilter, TimelineZoomLevel, and TimelineUpdateEvent. Define WebSocket event types for timeline updates (timeline:update, timeline:zoom, timeline:filter). Extend existing session models to include timeline-specific metadata like timestamps, duration, and event markers.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for data model validation, type safety checks for WebSocket events, and integration tests with existing session models

subtasks.title: Implement Timeline Lit Component Structure
subtasks.description: Build the base Lit Web Component for timeline visualization with zoom and pan controls
subtasks.details: Create timeline-view.ts in js/frontend/src/components/timeline/ using Lit's LitElement. Implement properties for timeRange, zoomLevel, sessions array, and activeFilters. Add methods for handleZoom, handlePan, and calculateViewport. Use CSS Grid or Flexbox for responsive layout with a horizontal timeline axis and session tracks.
subtasks.testStrategy: Component rendering tests with different viewport sizes, zoom level boundary tests, pan gesture tests, and performance tests with 100+ sessions

subtasks.title: Add Timeline Filtering and Search
subtasks.description: Implement filtering controls for session type, status, date range, and text search
subtasks.details: Create timeline-filters.ts component with filter UI controls for session status (active/completed/failed), date range picker, session type selector, and text search. Implement filter state management using Lit's reactive properties. Add debounced search and filter application logic. Emit filter-changed events to parent timeline component.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test filter combinations, verify debounce timing, test filter persistence across zoom/pan, and validate search performance with large datasets

subtasks.title: Integrate WebSocket Real-time Updates
subtasks.description: Connect timeline to WebSocket server for live session updates and synchronization
subtasks.details: Extend WebSocketManager in js/frontend/src/services/ to handle timeline-specific events. Implement subscription to session:created, session:updated, and session:deleted events. Add automatic timeline repositioning for new sessions. Implement optimistic UI updates with rollback on connection loss. Add visual indicators for real-time updates (pulse animations, badges).
subtasks.testStrategy: Test WebSocket reconnection handling, verify update batching under high load, test conflict resolution for concurrent updates, and validate memory management for long-running connections

subtasks.title: Add Timeline Interactions and Export
subtasks.description: Implement click handlers, tooltips, context menus, and export functionality
subtasks.details: Add click handlers to open session details in modal or side panel. Implement hover tooltips showing session summary using Lit's @query and template refs. Add right-click context menu for session actions (view, export, delete). Implement timeline export as PNG/SVG using canvas or SVG serialization. Add keyboard navigation (arrow keys for pan, +/- for zoom).
subtasks.testStrategy: Test interaction responsiveness, verify tooltip positioning at viewport edges, test export quality at different zoom levels, and validate keyboard accessibility compliance

tasks.title: Filtering and Search Functionality
tasks.description: Create filtering and search functionality with reactive properties
tasks.details: Implement real-time filtering by message types, date ranges, and full-text search across session content.
tasks.testStrategy: Test filtering with various criteria, verify search performance with large datasets, and test reactive updates

subtasks.title: Create Filter State Management with Lit Reactive Properties
subtasks.description: Implement reactive state management for all filter types using Lit's reactive properties and controllers
subtasks.details: Create a FilterController class extending ReactiveController to manage filter state including message type filters (user/assistant/system), date range filters (start/end dates), search query state, and active filter combinations. Use @state() decorators for reactive properties and implement methods for updating filter criteria. Store filter state in sessionStorage for persistence across page reloads.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test reactive property updates trigger re-renders, verify filter state persistence in sessionStorage, test filter combination logic, and validate controller lifecycle methods

subtasks.title: Build Filter UI Components with Material Design
subtasks.description: Create filter UI components using Lit and Material Web Components for user interaction
subtasks.details: Develop FilterPanel component with md-filled-text-field for search input with debouncing, md-filter-chip components for message type selection (user/assistant/system/error), md-date-picker or custom date range selector for temporal filtering, and md-icon-button for clearing filters. Implement keyboard shortcuts for quick filter access (Cmd+F for search, etc). Style components to match existing Material Design theme and ensure responsive layout.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test UI component rendering and interactions, verify keyboard shortcuts work correctly, test responsive behavior on different screen sizes, and validate Material Design compliance

subtasks.title: Implement Message Filtering Logic and Search Algorithm
subtasks.description: Create efficient filtering and search algorithms for message data with performance optimization
subtasks.details: Implement filterMessages() method that applies all active filters efficiently using Array.filter() with combined predicates. Create full-text search using String.includes() with case-insensitive matching for message content, tool names, and error messages. Add message type filtering by role property. Implement date range filtering using timestamp comparisons. Use memoization with WeakMap to cache filtered results and improve performance for repeated filter operations.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test filtering with large datasets (1000+ messages), verify search matches across all text fields, test date range edge cases, measure and optimize filter performance

subtasks.title: Integrate Filters with Session List and Timeline Components
subtasks.description: Connect filter functionality to existing session-list and timeline-view components with reactive updates
subtasks.details: Modify session-list component to accept FilterController instance and apply filters to displayed sessions. Update timeline-view to filter messages based on active criteria. Implement @watch() decorators to trigger re-renders when filter state changes. Add visual indicators showing active filter count in UI. Ensure smooth animations when filtering using CSS transitions. Maintain scroll position when filters are applied/removed.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test filter integration with both components, verify reactive updates occur instantly, test scroll position preservation, and validate visual feedback for active filters

subtasks.title: Add Search Highlighting and Filter Analytics
subtasks.description: Implement search result highlighting and analytics for filter usage patterns
subtasks.details: Create highlightSearchTerms() method using mark.js or custom implementation to highlight matched text in message content. Add search result count display and 'no results' state handling. Implement filter analytics tracking which filters are used most frequently. Add performance metrics for search operations using Performance API. Create exportable filter presets for common search patterns. Add URL state synchronization for shareable filtered views.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test highlighting works with special characters and HTML entities, verify analytics data collection, test URL state synchronization, and validate performance metrics accuracy

tasks.title: Responsive Layout System
tasks.description: Build responsive layout system using Lit's template system
tasks.details: Create a responsive layout that works on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices using Lit's template system and Tailwind CSS. Use Context7 MCP server for Lit templates, Tailwind CSS, and responsive design best practices.
tasks.testStrategy: Test layout on various screen sizes, verify responsive behavior, and ensure consistent styling

subtasks.title: Create Responsive Layout Component Base
subtasks.description: Implement base ResponsiveLayout Lit component with breakpoint detection and reactive properties
subtasks.details: Create a new Lit component at js/frontend/src/components/layout/ResponsiveLayout.ts that extends LitElement. Implement responsive breakpoint detection using ResizeObserver or matchMedia APIs. Define reactive properties for current breakpoint (mobile/tablet/desktop) and expose them via @property decorators. Set up Tailwind CSS breakpoint constants matching sm:, md:, lg:, xl: breakpoints. Create a base template structure with header, main content area, and optional sidebar slots using Lit's slot system.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test breakpoint detection logic with different viewport sizes, verify reactive property updates trigger re-renders, ensure slot content is properly projected

subtasks.title: Implement Grid and Flexbox Layout Templates
subtasks.description: Create responsive grid and flexbox layout templates using Lit's template system and Tailwind utilities
subtasks.details: Within the ResponsiveLayout component, implement conditional template rendering based on breakpoint. Create mobile-first grid layouts using Tailwind's grid classes (grid-cols-1, sm:grid-cols-2, lg:grid-cols-3). Implement flexbox layouts for navigation and sidebar areas with proper flex-direction changes on mobile. Use Lit's conditional rendering with ${when()} or ternary operators to switch between layout templates. Apply responsive padding/margin using Tailwind's spacing utilities (p-2, md:p-4, lg:p-6).
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify grid columns adjust correctly at each breakpoint, test flexbox direction changes on mobile, ensure spacing scales appropriately

subtasks.title: Build Responsive Navigation Component
subtasks.description: Create responsive navigation that transforms between desktop navbar and mobile hamburger menu
subtasks.details: Create js/frontend/src/components/layout/ResponsiveNav.ts component. Implement desktop horizontal navigation bar using Tailwind flex utilities. Create mobile hamburger menu with slide-out drawer using Lit's @state for menu open/closed state. Add smooth transitions using Tailwind's transition utilities (transition-transform, duration-300). Implement keyboard navigation support and ARIA attributes for accessibility. Use Lit's @query decorator to reference DOM elements for focus management.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test hamburger menu toggle functionality, verify keyboard navigation works, ensure ARIA attributes are correct, test transition animations

subtasks.title: Implement Responsive Timeline and Session Components
subtasks.description: Adapt existing timeline and session components to be fully responsive within the layout system
subtasks.details: Modify existing timeline component (js/frontend/src/components/timeline/TimelineComponent.ts) to use responsive Tailwind classes. Implement stacked layout for mobile with collapsible sections. Add horizontal scrolling for wide content on mobile using overflow-x-auto. Update session list and session view components to work within responsive grid. Implement responsive table layouts that transform to card layouts on mobile using Tailwind's hidden/block utilities at different breakpoints.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test timeline renders correctly at all breakpoints, verify collapsible sections work on mobile, ensure session components adapt layout appropriately

subtasks.title: Create Responsive Testing Page and Documentation
subtasks.description: Build comprehensive test page demonstrating all responsive layouts and document usage patterns
subtasks.details: Create js/frontend/test-responsive-layout.html page that showcases all responsive components. Include viewport size indicator showing current breakpoint for testing. Add examples of all layout variations (grid, flex, sidebar, no-sidebar). Create inline documentation comments in components explaining responsive patterns used. Set up visual regression testing markers for key breakpoints (320px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px). Include performance metrics for layout shifts and reflow events.
subtasks.testStrategy: Manually test on actual devices (iPhone, iPad, desktop), use browser DevTools device emulation, verify no layout shifts occur during responsive transitions

tasks.title: Claude Code CLI Integration
tasks.description: Implement Node.js child process management for Claude Code CLI integration
tasks.details: Create system for launching Claude Code sessions, managing child processes, and handling session resumption. Use Context7 MCP server for Node.js child processes, process management, and CLI integration best practices.
tasks.testStrategy: Test CLI integration with various scenarios, verify process management, and ensure proper error handling

subtasks.title: Set up Node.js child process spawning infrastructure
subtasks.description: Create core infrastructure for spawning and managing Claude Code CLI child processes
subtasks.details: Implement a ProcessManager class in js/backend/src/services/process-manager.ts that handles spawning Claude Code CLI processes using Node.js child_process.spawn(). Include process lifecycle management (start, stop, restart), environment variable handling, working directory configuration, and process ID tracking. Follow the existing service patterns seen in js/backend/src/services/websocket-service.ts.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests for ProcessManager class testing spawn operations, process termination, environment variable passing, and error handling for invalid commands or missing executables

subtasks.title: Implement stdout/stderr stream handling and parsing
subtasks.description: Create stream handlers for capturing and parsing Claude Code CLI output
subtasks.details: Develop StreamHandler class to capture stdout/stderr from child processes, implement buffering and line-by-line parsing, detect and parse different output types (JSON responses, markdown, tool use), and handle ANSI escape codes. Create event emitters for parsed output that can be consumed by WebSocket service. Store in js/backend/src/services/stream-handler.ts following existing TypeScript patterns.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test stream parsing with various Claude Code output formats, verify ANSI code handling, test buffer overflow scenarios, and ensure proper event emission for different output types

subtasks.title: Build session state persistence and recovery system
subtasks.description: Implement session state persistence for Claude Code CLI process resumption
subtasks.details: Create SessionStateManager in js/backend/src/services/session-state.ts that persists active session data including process IDs, working directories, environment variables, and command history to SQLite database. Implement recovery mechanism to restore sessions after application restart, handle orphaned processes, and clean up stale sessions. Use the existing database patterns from js/backend/src/database/.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test session persistence across application restarts, verify orphaned process cleanup, test recovery with various session states, and ensure database transactions are atomic

subtasks.title: Create WebSocket integration for real-time CLI output
subtasks.description: Integrate child process management with existing WebSocket infrastructure
subtasks.details: Extend js/backend/src/services/websocket-service.ts to handle Claude Code CLI events including process spawn/exit, stdout/stderr streaming, and session state changes. Implement WebSocket message types for CLI control (start, stop, restart, input) and output streaming. Ensure compatibility with existing WebSocket patterns and message formats defined in js/shared/src/types/.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test real-time output streaming over WebSocket, verify message ordering and buffering, test concurrent session handling, and ensure WebSocket reconnection preserves CLI session state

subtasks.title: Implement input handling and interactive mode support
subtasks.description: Build system for sending user input to Claude Code CLI processes
subtasks.details: Create InputHandler in js/backend/src/services/input-handler.ts for managing stdin writes to child processes, implement queue system for handling rapid input, support for special key sequences (Ctrl+C, Ctrl+D), and interactive mode detection. Add WebSocket message handlers for user input events and ensure proper input sanitization and validation.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test input handling with various input types, verify special key sequence handling, test input queue under load, and ensure proper handling of interactive prompts and multi-line input

tasks.title: Context Preparation and Transfer

tasks.details: Implement systems for preparing session context, transferring data between web app and Claude Code CLI, and managing session state.
tasks.testStrategy: Test context transfer with various session types, verify data integrity, and ensure seamless user experience

Integrate with existing SessionService caching mechanisms.

subtasks.title: Develop CLI Integration API Endpoints

subtasks.title: Develop Session State Management Bridge

Include event-driven updates and integration with existing session organization utilities.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test state synchronization scenarios, conflict resolution algorithms, transfer interruption recovery, and performance with concurrent state changes

tasks.details: Allow users to create new sessions that branch from specific points in history, with real-time notifications.

subtasks.title: Create Branch Point Selection UI Component

subtasks.details: Develop a Lit web component that displays session messages with branch point indicators. Add hover states and click handlers for message selection. subtasks.testStrategy: Test branch point selection with various message types, verify UI responsiveness and visual feedback, test integration with existing components

subtasks.title: Implement Branch Creation API Endpoint

Update the current basic reconnection in frontend (lines 236-264) and backend heartbeat monitoring (lines 173-213) to include more sophisticated retry strategies and failure detection.

Integrate with existing WebSocket events (session-updated, user-joined/left) and add new state-sync events. The manager should queue state changes during disconnection and reconcile them upon reconnection using the existing reconnect token system from ConnectionManager.

subtasks.details: Extend the existing ConnectionManager and EventManager to maintain state snapshots for each client session. subtasks.testStrategy: Test state persistence across server restarts and client reconnections. Verify efficient delta updates, proper cleanup of old snapshots, and integration with existing session management. Test memory usage with large state objects.

subtasks.details: Create a ConflictResolver class that implements various conflict resolution strategies: last-writer-wins, operational transforms for collaborative editing, semantic merge for non-conflicting changes, and user-prompted resolution for complex conflicts. Implement conflict detection using vector clocks or logical timestamps, automatic resolution for simple cases, and UI notifications for manual resolution. Integrate with the existing event system and session update mechanisms (session-update events in websocket.ts lines 177-195).

subtasks.title: Generate Developer Documentation with TypeDoc
subtasks.description: Set up TypeDoc for automatic TypeScript documentation generation
subtasks.details: Install and configure TypeDoc with appropriate plugins (typedoc-plugin-markdown, typedoc-theme-hierarchy). Document all TypeScript interfaces, classes, and functions with JSDoc comments in shared/, backend/src/, and frontend/src/. Configure TypeDoc to generate both HTML and Markdown documentation. Create custom theme matching the application's design. Set up documentation deployment pipeline to GitHub Pages or similar.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify TypeDoc generates without errors, check all public APIs are documented, validate internal links work correctly, ensure documentation is searchable

subtasks.title: Create README and Getting Started Guides
subtasks.description: Write comprehensive README files and quick start documentation
subtasks.details: Write main README.md with project overview, features, architecture diagram, and installation instructions. Create CONTRIBUTING.md with development setup, coding standards, and PR guidelines. Write separate README files for backend/, frontend/, and shared/ modules. Include troubleshooting section for common issues. Add code examples for extending functionality and creating custom components. Document environment variables and configuration options.
subtasks.testStrategy: Follow installation steps on clean system, verify all commands work as documented, test code examples compile and run, validate links and references

subtasks.title: Develop Video Tutorials and Demo Content
subtasks.description: Create video tutorials and interactive demos for user onboarding
subtasks.details: Record screen capture videos demonstrating key workflows: uploading JSONL files, navigating sessions, using timeline features, and exporting data. Create animated GIFs for README showing main features. Build interactive demo mode with sample data that users can explore without uploading files. Implement in-app video player for tutorial content. Create transcript and closed captions for accessibility.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test videos play correctly in different browsers, verify demo mode works with sample data, ensure tutorials cover all major features, validate accessibility features work properly

tasks.title: WebSocket Connection Stability
tasks.description: WebSocket connection stability and error handling
tasks.details: Implement robust error handling for WebSocket connections, connection monitoring, and graceful degradation.
tasks.testStrategy: Test WebSocket stability under various conditions, verify error handling, and ensure graceful degradation

subtasks.title: Implement WebSocket Connection Health Monitor
subtasks.description: Create a health monitoring system for WebSocket connections with heartbeat/ping-pong mechanism
subtasks.details: Implement a heartbeat system in js/backend/src/services/websocket.ts that sends periodic ping messages to connected clients and tracks response times. Add connection state tracking (connected, connecting, disconnected, error) with timestamps for last successful communication. Create metrics for connection uptime, latency, and dropped messages. Integrate with existing WebSocket server implementation from Task 3.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test heartbeat mechanism with simulated network delays, verify connection state transitions are tracked correctly, test timeout detection and handling

subtasks.title: Create Exponential Backoff Reconnection Strategy
subtasks.description: Implement intelligent reconnection logic with exponential backoff and jitter
subtasks.details: Enhance the reconnection logic in js/frontend/src/services/websocket-client.ts with exponential backoff algorithm (initial delay 1s, max 30s, factor 1.5). Add jitter to prevent thundering herd problem. Implement maximum retry attempts with configurable limits. Track reconnection attempts and success rates. Coordinate with the health monitor to determine when reconnection is needed. Build upon the basic reconnection from Task 19.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test reconnection with various network failure scenarios, verify backoff timing increases correctly, test maximum retry limit enforcement, simulate rapid disconnect/reconnect cycles

subtasks.title: Implement Circuit Breaker Pattern for WebSocket Operations
subtasks.description: Add circuit breaker pattern to prevent cascading failures and provide graceful degradation
subtasks.details: Create a circuit breaker implementation in js/shared/src/websocket-circuit-breaker.ts with three states: closed (normal operation), open (failing, reject requests), and half-open (testing recovery). Configure thresholds for failure rate (50% over 10 requests) and timeout periods (30 seconds). Implement fallback mechanisms to queue critical messages during outages. Provide status reporting for monitoring dashboard integration.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test circuit breaker state transitions with controlled failures, verify fallback mechanisms activate correctly, test recovery from open to half-open to closed states

subtasks.title: Add Comprehensive Error Handling and Recovery
subtasks.description: Implement detailed error handling for all WebSocket failure scenarios with recovery strategies
subtasks.details: Create error handlers in both js/backend/src/services/websocket.ts and js/frontend/src/services/websocket-client.ts for: connection timeouts, authentication failures, protocol errors, message parsing errors, and server overload. Implement specific recovery strategies for each error type. Add error classification system (transient vs permanent). Create user-friendly error messages and notifications. Log errors with context for debugging.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test each error scenario individually, verify appropriate recovery strategy is triggered, test error message display to users, verify error logging includes sufficient context

subtasks.title: Implement Message Queue and Delivery Guarantees
subtasks.description: Create message queueing system for reliable message delivery during connection issues
subtasks.details: Implement message queue in js/frontend/src/services/message-queue.ts with persistence using IndexedDB for critical messages. Add message acknowledgment system with unique message IDs. Implement retry logic for failed message delivery with deduplication. Create priority levels for messages (critical, normal, low). Add queue size limits and overflow handling. Synchronize queue state after successful reconnection.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test message queueing during disconnection, verify message persistence across page reloads, test message deduplication, verify priority ordering is maintained

tasks.title: Beta Release Preparation
tasks.description: Prepare for beta release and user feedback collection
tasks.details: Finalize beta version, set up feedback collection mechanisms, and prepare for user testing.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify beta release readiness, test feedback collection, and ensure smooth user experience

subtasks.title: Implement Beta Version Configuration
subtasks.description: Create beta version configuration system with feature flags and environment settings
subtasks.details: Set up configuration files for beta environment, implement feature flags for beta-only features, configure build scripts for beta deployment, add version management with clear beta labeling, and ensure proper environment variable handling for beta vs production modes
subtasks.testStrategy: Test feature flag toggling, verify beta configuration isolation from production, validate build output for beta markers, and ensure environment variables are correctly loaded

subtasks.title: Create User Feedback Collection System
subtasks.description: Build comprehensive feedback collection interface with multiple feedback types and persistence
subtasks.details: Implement feedback widget component using Lit Web Components, create feedback API endpoints for submission and storage, add feedback categories (bugs, features, general), integrate with session context for automatic metadata collection, implement rate limiting and validation for feedback submissions
subtasks.testStrategy: Test feedback submission flow end-to-end, verify data persistence and retrieval, validate rate limiting works correctly, test feedback widget rendering across different views

subtasks.title: Setup Beta Analytics and Monitoring
subtasks.description: Implement analytics tracking and performance monitoring for beta usage patterns
subtasks.details: Integrate analytics service for tracking user interactions, implement performance monitoring for WebSocket connections and UI responsiveness, add error tracking with detailed stack traces, create usage metrics dashboard, implement privacy-compliant user session tracking
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify analytics events are properly tracked, test performance metric collection accuracy, validate error reporting captures necessary details, ensure GDPR/privacy compliance

subtasks.title: Create Beta Documentation and Onboarding
subtasks.description: Develop comprehensive beta documentation and user onboarding experience
subtasks.details: Write beta release notes highlighting new features and known limitations, create interactive onboarding tour for first-time users, develop troubleshooting guide for common beta issues, implement in-app help system with contextual guidance, prepare feedback submission guidelines
subtasks.testStrategy: Test onboarding flow with fresh installations, verify documentation links work correctly, validate help system provides relevant context, ensure feedback guidelines are accessible

subtasks.title: Beta Deployment and Release Pipeline
subtasks.description: Set up automated deployment pipeline and release process for beta distribution
subtasks.details: Configure CI/CD pipeline for beta builds with automated testing, set up beta distribution channels (npm beta tag, GitHub releases), implement rollback mechanism for critical issues, create beta user access control and invitation system, establish beta testing timeline and milestone tracking
subtasks.testStrategy: Test deployment pipeline with mock releases, verify rollback procedures work correctly, validate access control restricts beta to authorized users, ensure version management correctly handles beta releases

tasks.details: Add advanced features like code analysis, pattern recognition, cross-session linking, and learning insights.
